svg.title: ChemAudit: Validate, standardize and score structures before they feed a model or a database. An inspection line. A carrier with a ball-and-stick model of aspirin's sodium salt rides a conveyor. Gauge 1 reads its ChemAudit validation score, 85. At the cleaning station a vacuum pick-off lifts the sodium ion into a salt bin and the carboxylate's charge mark goes, as ChEMBL get_parent strips the salt and neutralises the acid. Gauge 2 reads the parent acid: 100.
